test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Mechanic Diesel) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the statements is correct about a compression ignition engine?

options.text: Diesel engine produces less noise compared to petrol engine.
Operating speed range is less compared to petrol engine.
Starting is easy for diesel engine since less cranking effort is required compared to petrol engine.
Initial and maintenance costs of diesel engine is less compared to petrol engine.

solution:
The correct answer is __Operating speed range is less compared to petrol engine**(Option 2)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Compression Ignition Engine__ is commonly referred to as a Diesel Engine.
 
• Diesel engines generally have a lower operating speed range compared to petrol engines.
 
• The combustion process in diesel engines is based on auto-ignition of fuel due to high compression ratios.
 
• Diesel engines are known for their higher efficiency but are noisier compared to petrol engines.
 
• Starting diesel engines requires more cranking effort due to higher compression ratios.
 
• The initial cost and maintenance cost of diesel engines are generally higher than those of petrol engines.
 
• Diesel engines are widely used in heavy-duty applications like trucks and buses.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Petrol Engine:**

 
 
• Petrol engines operate at higher speeds due to spark ignition.
 
• They are generally quieter and have lower vibration levels compared to diesel engines.
 
 
 
• **Diesel Engine Applications: **
 
 
• Diesel engines are used in marine vessels, agricultural equipment, and generators.
 
• They are preferred for long-distance and heavy-load transport.
 
 
 
• **Efficiency Comparison:**
 
 
• Diesel engines have a higher thermal efficiency than petrol engines.
 
• Petrol engines have lower compression ratios.
